GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and Biodiversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Skeletal and Muscular System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
